findings.design: One hatch_0 protocol;10000 measurements; fixed control target and exogenous settings; fan loads generated by feedback.
findings.reason: Inspected design supplies no sequence crossing sensor and plant-mechanism changes. Future realized fan loads are endogenous, not an externally supplied open-loop plan.

findings.design: Ten seeds; intake-load values0.01/0.1/0.2/0.5; ten input interventions per protocol; other settings held fixed.
findings.reason: The inspected changepoints are actuator-input changes. They do not document a changed plant transition law or sequential unknown sensor interface.

findings.design: 10000 measurements; fixed sensor settings; first polarizer sweeps-90..180; three blocks alter input distributions.
findings.reason: Can study a declared optical/interface effect, but this design does not also establish changing underlying dynamics. Treating every actuator or distribution change as a new law is invalid.

findings.design: Buchholz:10000 independent SCM samples per environment. CITRIS:100000 temporal actuator states after1000 burn-in steps; per-step interventions; both have fixed camera settings.
findings.available_role: Physical nonlinear observations of static-SCM or controlled temporal latent factors, respectively.
findings.reason: The two protocols must not be conflated. Intervention environments and temporal state changes are not documented sequential camera/sensor replacements plus plant-law changes. Future nonintervened actuator states must be simulated if used as latent state, not supplied as known drivers.

history_scope: Limited direct C22/C69 evidence. No project-wide never-used certification; original C22 wind records and C69 scored records excluded from fresh-cohort claims.
next_action: Identify independently unused, sufficiently excited physical records; if observation shifts are constructed, declare them synthetic measurement interventions over real trajectories. Keep plant-input shifts separate from plant-law changes. Compare complete ordinary observation-adapter/state-space/replay controls before designing a new mechanism.
